summary: Research iteration 3 repaired STU-001 for the Claude 1962 All Saints leaf. Victorinus of Pettau was read in the tracked ANF VII text (ccel-text-b69327af) at chapter 7: the comment on 7:2 at lines 33567-33618 and on 7:9 at lines 33620-33625. The 12:6 comment on the 144,000 (lines 33964-33974) and the recension cautions in the elucidations (lines 34467-34545) were also read. The false negative is corrected in scope.md: the header, section 1 (iteration-3 paragraph and the whole-context reading), 3.3, the section 4 table, 5.1, section 6 item 1, section 7, section 10 items 5, 12 and 13, and section 11. Victorinus is bound as binding 42 with deferred rows for 7:2 and 7:9 (direct-exegesis) and for 12:6 (analogue). He has no author-standing row, so he is a developed supporting and rival witness and never carries. The proportionate second search found Augustine (father) agreeing with Bede on the number and the crowd in three brief loci: De doctrina christiana III.35.50-51 (binding 44), Letter XCIII section 30 (binding 43) and Sermon LXI (added to binding 17). It also found Bellarmine (doctor) supporting Bede by analogue on Ps 86:2 and 121:2 (added to binding 19), and Cyprian, Ad Fortunatum section 11, as a martyrs-only rival (binding 45). The PL 35 lead for Caesarius was followed to the registered scan b3ff8a95, which was fetched, hash-matched and read on page images. The work printed there is the anonymous Expositio in Apocalypsim. Its Admonitio (cols. 2415-2416) says it is stitched together from Victorinus, Primasius and Bede and names no Caesarius. Homily VI (cols. 2426-2428) reads the 144,000 and the crowd as the whole Church and the robes as baptism, not martyrs only. It is bound as binding 46: dependent reception that never carries. interpretations.md Reading A now states what Victorinus contributes (the elect from all believers, the baptismal robes, the grace kept) and where he disagrees with Bede (the angel is Elias; the setting is the last times; the 144,000 are a particular company). It adds Augustine's Apocalypse loci as brief applications, not a commentary. It sets out the patristic disagreement over the number, the crowd and the angel in Strongest difficulty and in the comparison's witness base. The proper-study check (research phase), source-dispositions and source-library validate all pass.
